Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Zahra Hussain — reference debrief and notes

Team — quick debrief following the call with Rohit (25 minutes) and attached notes (zahra_reference_notes.txt). Highlights: 

- Role & context: Rohit supervised Zahra for ~3 years at Acme Analytics; Zahra led infra work on a cross-team migration to microservices that included billing-path changes.
- Impact: migration reduced tail latency by ~20% for the billing pipeline and lowered incident rate for the billing flow (Rohit estimated 2 fewer Sev2 incidents/month).
- Ownership: Zahra reportedly drove the design, owned rollout strategy, and wrote the initial postmortem after a production incident — good ownership demonstrated.
- Communication: strong cross-team communicator; proactively set runbooks and on-call handoffs.
- People: coached two junior SREs; positive mentorship noted.
- Concerns: Rohit called out occasional tight timelines where Zahra prioritized delivery over documentation—manageable but worth calling out.

Action items: 
1) Marissa — please add these notes to Greenhouse (candidate ID 12345678) and flag for interview loop debrief.
2) David — would you like me to schedule a final loop screen with Zahra (technical design deep-dive) or move to offer-stage prep?

Attachments: zahra_reference_notes.txt (short bullet notes + call transcript highlights)

Thanks all — grateful to Rohit for his time.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
